title: ₹1 every second vs Ambani: how long?
caption:
If you earned ₹1 every second, how long until you're as rich as Mukesh Ambani? 🤯

Guess before Bittu reveals it 👀 (comment your guess first!)

₹1 a second = ₹86,400 a day = just over ₹3 crore a year.
Start the day the pyramids were built, 4,500 years ago, and today you'd have ₹14,200 crore.
Ambani has about ₹7 lakh crore (Forbes, Nov 2026). That's almost 50× more.

The answer: more than 2 lakh years. Humans hadn't even invented farming back then.
